page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking a talented Principal Enterprise Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will lead the creation and enforcement of our Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) for Gainwell Technologies' product portfolio and direct the resolution of tactical architecture issues to support business strategy while positioning the company for growth and agility.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#primary-duties]

### Primary Duties

- Lead the development and maintenance of the Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) to drive technology transformation
- Direct the implementation and governance of Reference Architecture across Business, Application, Information, Infrastructure Technology, Service Management, and Security domains
- Lead evaluation of new technologies and software products to determine feasibility and alignment with ERA
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#architecture--design]

### Architecture & Design

- Design technology solutions requiring integration of multiple platforms, operating systems, and applications across the enterprise
- Develop architecture patterns and standards that guide technology solution design
- Create detailed technical documentation and architecture artifacts
- Support architecting cloud-native implementations on AWS and Azure platforms
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#collaboration--leadership]

### Collaboration & Leadership

- Work with Sales and Product Management on RFP/RFI responses to ensure technical accuracy and alignment with product capabilities
- Collaborate with third-party vendors and partners on application integration projects
- Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) meetings and governance processes
- Mentor junior architects and provide technical guidance to development teams
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#documentation--communication]

### Documentation & Communication

- Create and maintain architecture documentation, standards, and guidelines
- Present architecture solutions to stakeholders and technical teams
- Contribute to knowledge sharing initiatives within the Enterprise Architecture Practice
- Document technical decisions and rationale for future reference
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#compliance--governance]

### Compliance & Governance

- Ensure adherence to ERA guidelines in solution design and implementation
- Support compliance with healthcare regulations including HIPAA, MITA, and FedRAMP
- Participate in architecture governance processes and reviews
- Monitor and report on architecture metrics and compliance

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in relevant technical field
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 10+ years of experience in application architecture and solution design
- **Required**: 3+ years of enterprise architecture experience working across business domains
- **Preferred**: 6+ years of experience in healthcare technology or government systems
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#core-architecture-skills]

#### Core Architecture Skills

- Enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, or equivalent)
- Architecture modeling tools (Markdown, Mermaid, Draw.io, UML, C4 Diagraming)
- Solution design and technical documentation
- Software development lifecycle methodologies
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#technology-expertise]

#### Technology Expertise

- Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) with focus on cloud-native implementations
- Integration technologies, APIs, and middleware
- Database technologies and data architecture
- Enterprise software systems and applications
- Programming languages and development frameworks
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#programming--development]

#### Programming & Development

- Proficiency in modern programming languages (Java, C#, Python, etc.)
- Understanding of software architecture patterns and design principles
- Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for technical documentation
- Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
- Generative AI tools for architecture design, analysis, and innovation
- AI agents and automation tools for enterprise architecture and governance
page_texts.19:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- TOGAF 9 Certified Practitioner
- AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect
- Industry-specific certifications (healthcare, government)

---
page_texts.21:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#industry-experience]

### Industry Experience

- Experience in healthcare technology and Medicaid systems
- Knowledge of government healthcare programs (Medicaid, CHIP, SNAP, TANF, WIC, LIHEAP)
- Understanding of HIPAA, MITA, and healthcare compliance requirements
- Experience with Health and Human Services interoperability standards (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, IX4HS, NIEM)
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#domain-expertise]

### Domain Expertise

- Recipient engagement design patterns for digital channels
- Security protocols including Secure Messaging, ADA Section 508, FedRAMP
- Enterprise data management and information architecture
- Service-oriented architecture and microservices patterns
- Experience with Generative AI integration and governance in enterprise architectures
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#leadership--communication]

### Leadership & Communication

- Proven experience working with large, diverse technical teams
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Experience presenting to executive leadership and business stakeholders
- Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills

---
page_texts.25:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#technical-competencies]

### Technical Competencies

- **Systems Thinking**: Ability to understand complex systems and their interdependencies
- **Solution Design**: Capability to design scalable, maintainable solutions
- **Technology Evaluation**: Skills in assessing and selecting appropriate technologies
- **Risk Assessment**: Ability to identify and mitigate technical and business risks
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#business-competencies]

### Business Competencies

- **Strategic Thinking**: Understanding of business strategy and alignment
- **Stakeholder Management**: Ability to work with diverse stakeholder groups
- **Change Management**: Experience driving organizational and technical change
- **Process Improvement**: Skills in analyzing and optimizing business processes
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/principal-enterprise-architect.md#leadership-competencies]

### Leadership Competencies

- **Influence**: Ability to influence without direct authority
- **Collaboration**: Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration skills
- **Mentoring**: Capability to guide and develop team members
- **Decision Making**: Strong analytical and decision-making abilities

---
